evidence.quoted_text: matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('ExecStart=')]
evidence.reason: The current renderer only recognizes an ExecStart directive when the physical line begins exactly with `ExecStart=`. A valid systemd assignment written as `ExecStart = ...` produces zero matches, and the following exact-one check raises `ValueError`, so the render/replace path rejects a valid template. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing intended parser behavior, not a new requirement.
